description: Exercise habit changes from running to cycling; exam date corrected; project deadline reported.

key.correction: exam is Nov 20, not in December
key.event: project submission Oct 9, reported Oct 10: submitted on time, one section rushed
key.recurring_worry: not enough sleep because of studying late, 4 conversations

messages: Hi, I'm Neha. I'm a final-year civil engineering student in Jaipur.
I go running every morning before class.
I study until two in the morning most days and I'm always sleepy.
Okay, that's all for now.
Ran five kilometres today in the cool morning air.
I fell asleep in the structures lecture.
Good night.
I made a model bridge with my project group.
My exams are in December I think, I need to check the date.
Talk soon.
I slept four hours again and it shows.
My group wants to meet at night because everyone is busy in the day.
Bye for now.
Went to a lake with friends on Saturday.
Best day in weeks.
That's all.
The project submission is on October 9.
We still have the report to write.
Good night.
I got a bicycle from my cousin, a proper geared one.
I've switched from running to cycling in the mornings, it's much more fun.
I also checked the notice: my exam is on November 20, not in December.
I told you December earlier, that was wrong.
So I have less time than I thought.
I'll make a study plan this week.
I'll keep you posted on how it goes.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
Cycled 12 kilometres before class, I felt great.
I'm still sleeping too little though.
Talk soon.
We're finishing the report tonight, it's going to be a long night.
I'll probably get three hours of sleep.
Goodnight.
We submitted the project today.
I'm exhausted but relieved.
I'll tell you how it went tomorrow.
We submitted on time yesterday, though one section was rushed.
The professor said the bridge model was impressive.
I'm just happy it's over.
Started exam preparation, there's so much to cover.
I cycled in the morning again, it clears my head.
See you.
Studying again until very late.
I know I should sleep more but there's no time.
Thanks for listening.

probes.question: What exercise do I do in the mornings?
Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention switching from running to cycling; maybe the corrected exam date.

probes.question: Is my lack of sleep a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
How did my project submission go?
probes.expected: Submitted on time (Oct 9); one section was rushed; professor praised the bridge model.

probes.question: When is my exam?
probes.expected: November 20 (not December); it has not happened yet.
